# circularbuffer/cleanup/close/create/devctrl/info/legacy/misc/pnp/power/rw/serial.c
# replaced by Rust (serial-rust); guid.c stays C (GUID data TU). NOT boot-loaded in smoke
# (kernel owns the KD COM port) -> link-clean x3 bar.

# serial.sys is all Rust (serial-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/serial-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(serial_shims OBJECT guid.c)
target_link_libraries(serial_shims PRIVATE libntoskrnl libhal)
add_cargo_module(serial serial-cargo serial.sys
    KIND kernelmodedriver
    BODY_CRATE serial-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32/drivers
    EXTRA_DEPENDS serial_shims psdk)
